title: Argentinian Beef Asado
description: A classic Argentinian dish featuring slow-cooked beef in a rich and savory sauce.

ingredients.name: Beef (Asado Cut)
ingredients.notes: such as flank steak or skirt steak

instructions: Preheat the grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the beef with salt, black pepper, and Nutrient-Rich Chimol.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Sear the beef on both sides until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the beef to a plate and set aside.
Add the minced garlic and red pepper flakes to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Rich Beef Broth and Chimichurri to the pot, scraping up any browned bits.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 2-3 hours, or until the beef is tender.
If using chorizo, add it to the pot for the last 30 minutes of cooking.
Let the beef rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
